svg.title: Ukimta: specifying the case / אוקימתא
svg.desc: Chapter 9, Hebrew pp163–165, English pp164–166. Unchanged wording at the top accompanies a narrowing funnel and one bounded case below. Ukimta supplies a condition restricting the application while retaining the plain meaning of the words. The funnel restricts the case, not the wording. This is a method of explanation, not a third grade of fit or necessarily a forced reading.
